countInfo.Council_Name: Newry No. 1 (County Down) Rural District Council

source.title: Irish News, 18 May 1949, p. 3 ("Rural council nominations in the North")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Newry No. 1 (County Down) rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. There were no contests in the district; the Irish News prints the nominations, of which the clearly legible ones are recorded here. No nominations were received for Clonduff and Mayo, whose outgoing members were to retain their seats. Returned unopposed.
